About this video

Is the AI bubble bursting, and what does it mean for your 401(k)? If you own an S&P 500 index fund, about $6.05 of every $100 is Nvidia, and Nvidia's stock fell 37.6% from its Oct 6 high ($239.24) to $149.30 on Nov 25, 2026, after a +31.5% one-day jump on Nov 23.
